description: FIXTURE DATA (offline demo, not live): postmortem excerpts for the checkout service.

items.content: Incident INC-1042: checkout latency spiked to 2.3s p95 after the 2026-09-14 deploy because the new recommendations query ran without a covering index.
Incident INC-1051: payment authorizations failed for 40 minutes on 2026-09-28; root cause was an expired TLS certificate on the payments-gateway upstream.
Incident INC-1058: checkout error rate rose to 4% during the 2026-10-06 traffic surge; autoscaler capped at 20 pods by a stale HPA maxReplicas setting.
